title: Is an Atlantic Basin crude glut on the cards?
section_path: Is an Atlantic Basin crude glut on the cards?
section_path_text: Is an Atlantic Basin crude glut on the cards?
summary:
Main
Atlantic crude discounts fail to offset high freight to Asia, raising the risk of a regional glut as VLCC availability tightens. By George Morris

Freight erodes Atlantic crude's price advantage for Asian refiners
Atlantic Basin crude differentials fell to record lows in mid-October (Argus), but discounts have failed to offset the cost of shipping barrels to Asia. VLCC freight to Ningbo costs $8-16/bbl more from Atlantic origins than from Fujairah over the four weeks to Oct 25, versus $1-3/bbl through 2025.

children.title: Middle East barrels have the advantage in Asia
section_path: Middle East barrels have the advantage in Asia
children.section_path_text: Middle East barrels have the advantage in Asia
children.summary: Mainstream Middle East seaborne crude/condensate exports returned to pre-war levels by 1 October, while seaborne crude and condensate exports reached a seasonal high on 14 October, despite vessel attacks reaching a weekly record in the week commencing 28 September. Pricing is reinforcing the region's advantage as supply returns.

children.title: The VLCC shortage is concentrated in the Atlantic
section_path: The VLCC shortage is concentrated in the Atlantic
children.section_path_text: The VLCC shortage is concentrated in the Atlantic
children.summary: Recovering MEG volumes have drawn VLCC tonnage east , leaving fewer ships available for Atlantic cargoes. Ballast VLCCs heading to the Atlantic fell to a six-year low on 15 October and remain 30% below the 2025 average.

children.title: Charterers are using more Suezmaxes in the South Atlantic

children.section_path_text: Charterers are using more Suezmaxes in the South Atlantic
children.summary:
October fixtures (days 1-23) show charterers favouring more available Suezmax supply. Fixtures thus far for West Africa and South America East Coast versus year ago levels:

children.title: Freight correction could ease pressure on differentials
section_path: Freight correction could ease pressure on differentials
children.section_path_text: Freight correction could ease pressure on differentials
children.summary: Global VLCC freight rates have dropped off from recent highs, and the Atlantic premium is narrowing too. The Atlantic-Asia VLCC basket fell 18% in the w/c 19 Oct, against a 7% decline East of Suez.
